_comment: The eye-level shot is the one that matters: a rail is a thing you ride
toward at speed, and whether its bend reads as a bend at 6 m on the
engine's own lens is the only question worth asking about it.

shots.name: R_rail_family
shots.caption: RISE / LAUNCH / WEAVE, AND BATCH 009'S STRAIGHT FOR SCALE
shots.note: SIDE ON, BECAUSE A RAIL'S WHOLE SHAPE IS ITS ELEVATION

shots.name: R_rail_launch
shots.caption: LAUNCH - DIPS AT 40% OF THE RUN, NOT THE MIDDLE
shots.note: A SYMMETRIC VALLEY GIVES BACK WHAT IT TOOK. THIS TRADES HEIGHT FOR DISTANCE

shots.name: R_rail_ride
shots.caption: RIDING AT IT - 4.6 M OUT, THE ENGINE'S OWN LENS
shots.note: DOES THE BEND READ AS A BEND FROM WHERE THE PLAYER MEETS IT?

shots.name: R_rail_weave_above
shots.caption: WEAVE FROM ABOVE - THE WIDEST LATERAL SWING THAT FITS
shots.note: +/- 0.27 M. FOOTPRINT HALF_WIDTH IS 0.5 AND THE RAIL IS 0.42 WIDE
